question: Should `scripts/check-workflows.mjs` expose `OPENCLAW_CHECK_WORKFLOWS_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS` as a supported environment override, or should the fix retain only the fixed default timeout?
rationale: The timeout fix itself is bounded, but the repository policy sets a high bar for new environment/configuration surfaces and the supplied evidence does not establish why a new knob is required.

options.title: Keep only the fixed default
options.body: Remove the environment override and retain the five-minute bounded timeout, avoiding a new configuration contract.

options.title: Approve the override explicitly
options.body: Keep the capped environment variable as an intentional developer/CI contract and document its support boundary and validation expectations.

recommendation.title: Keep only the fixed default
recommendation.body: Remove the environment override and retain the five-minute bounded timeout, avoiding a new configuration contract.
